label: PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces — lane S, synthetic. Not evidence about real crowding.
caveats: PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces — lane S, synthetic. Not evidence about real crowding.
Rendered video: H.264 compression, but no sensor-noise model. Quiet-scene results are optimistic by an unknown margin (Day 17).
Not the Tier-1 economic claim: 60 s windows of authored scenes, not 24 h of real footage.

Observability proxy: visible 2D box area stands in for silhouette area. A box overstates a silhouette, so more frames land above the envelope than an instance mask would put there. NOT comparable with v3-v6 scorecards.
Loaded Transporters (Warehouse_010-016) and the Warehouse_019 stacker have 2D boxes that include their payload (Day 41 reprojection); their box area overstates the 3D object's.
No timing, CPU or latency figure is measured or reported (Day 19).

sampling_rule.rule: per scene: rank cameras by mean GT-visible boxes per frame over the window, split into quiet/busy halves, draw one from each half with numpy default_rng(seed)

source_scenes.observability_proxy: box_area: 2D visible-box area stands in for silhouette area (proxy)

metrics.name: gate.wake_fraction
metrics.detail: 58054 of 64440 presented frames reached stage 1. The primary number: everything else on this trade is read against it.

baselines.name: always_wake
baselines.description: wake on every frame

baselines.name: never_wake
baselines.description: sleep on every frame; the floor no functioning gate reaches

metrics.name: gate.recall_retained
metrics.detail: 48361 of 48852 moving frames woke the next stage — recall relative to always-wake (whose recall is 1.0 by construction), not absolute recall. This is the loss side of the trade.

baselines.name: always_wake
baselines.description: recall relative to always-wake is 1.0 by construction

baselines.name: never_wake
baselines.description: sleep on every frame; recall retained is 0.0

metrics.name: gate.compute_saved
metrics.detail: 6386 of 64440 frames never reached stage 1, x 20.0 ms/frame PLACEHOLDER downstream cost (DetectorStage is an unimplemented stub — see PLACEHOLDER_DOWNSTREAM_COST_MS_PER_FRAME). This is an ESTIMATE under a stated, unmeasured cost model, not a measurement.

baselines.name: always_wake
baselines.description: wake on every frame; no downstream compute is ever saved

baselines.name: never_wake
baselines.description: sleep on every frame; the maximum saving under the stated (unmeasured) cost model — unreachable by a gate that must sometimes wake

metrics.name: gate.miss_cost
metrics.detail: Of the 48852 reportable (above-envelope) frames, 491 were slept through. NOT importance-weighted: this synthetic set carries no per-event importance annotation, so every reportable frame counts equally — a real weighting requires Site Zero data.

baselines.name: always_wake
baselines.description: wake on every frame; no reportable frame is ever missed

baselines.name: never_wake
baselines.description: sleep on every frame; every reportable frame is missed

metrics.name: dataset.moving_frame_fraction
metrics.detail: 63670 of 64440 presented frames contain world motion by ANY agent, camera-independent. The denominator gate.wake_fraction must be read against: a gate cannot beat the scene's own motion density, and v3 was authored to contain moving agents. This measures the gate's mechanism, not the Tier-1 economic claim -- that requires wake fraction over 24 hours of real office footage including nights and weekends, which does not yet exist.

baselines.name: set_property
baselines.description: descriptor of the set, not of any model — no strategy applies

metrics.name: envelope.limited_misses
metrics.detail: Visible, unoccluded motion too small for the gate to resolve at 320x180. NOT a gate defect and NOT tunable away — this is the camera's capability envelope, and it is a mount-position and coverage input.

baselines.name: set_property
baselines.description: descriptor of the set, not of any model — no strategy applies

metrics.name: envelope.unobservable_frames
metrics.detail: Frames whose GT motion put no pixels on this sensor. Excluded from every denominator: scoring them would ask a camera to see through its own frustum.

baselines.name: set_property
baselines.description: descriptor of the set, not of any model — no strategy applies

metrics.name: envelope.wakes_outside_envelope
metrics.detail: Wakes on excluded frames — neither TP nor FP, but still compute. Reported so the excluded buckets cannot hide a wake storm; the stay-awake latch is the expected cause.

metrics.name: coverage.observable_fraction
metrics.detail: 49622 of 64440 frames carried ground truth this camera could act on. Read every rate above against this: a recall of 1.0 over a set that is mostly unobservable is a statement about the set, not about the gate.
